I recently obtained my Master's in statistics and data science.
My [thesis](https://janhove.github.io/SlicedWasserstein_Vanhove.pdf)
was on _sliced Wasserstein distances and their application to regression problems_.
This time last year, I didn't know what sliced Wasserstein distances
were, let alone how they could be applied to regression problems.
